facts.text: Haverford maintains academic partnerships with Bryn Mawr and Swarthmore, and full-time students can also enroll in courses at the University of Pennsylvania without extra tuition charges.

sources.title: Special Academic Programs < Haverford College
sources.quote: In addition to the cooperative agreement with Bryn Mawr and Swarthmore, Haverford has made arrangements with the University of Pennsylvania, and full-time Haverford students are permitted to have library privileges and, upon presentation of the proper credentials, to enroll for courses there without added expense.
